title: C++ STL Tutorial
description: The three pillars of the STL — containers, iterators and algorithms — and how they fit together. This chapter is the gateway to the standard library.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: STL 的三大支柱：容器、迭代器與演算法，以及它們如何配合。這一章是進入標準程式庫的入口。

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT one of the classic STL components?

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪一項不是經典 STL 的組成部分？

explanation.zh-Hant: STL 由容器、迭代器、演算法、函式物件與配接器組成；編譯器是工具，不屬於 STL。

questions.explanation: The STL is built from containers, iterators, algorithms, function objects and adaptors. The compiler is a tool, not part of the STL.

questions.prompt: Which container stores unique keys in sorted order?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個容器會以排序順序儲存不重複的鍵？

explanation.zh-Hant: std::set 是關聯容器，鍵自動排序且不可重複；vector 與 list 是序列容器，queue 是配接器。

questions.explanation: std::set is an associative container: keys are unique and kept in sorted order. vector and list are sequence containers, and queue is an adaptor.

questions.prompt: Which header must be included to call std::sort?

prompt.zh-Hant: 要呼叫 std::sort，必須包含哪一個標頭檔？

explanation.zh-Hant: <algorithm> 提供 sort、find、transform 等演算法；<numeric> 提供 accumulate 等數值演算法。

questions.explanation: <algorithm> declares sort, find and transform. <numeric> holds numeric algorithms such as accumulate, and <iterator> holds iterator utilities.

prompt.zh-Hant: 執行 `std::vector<int> v; v.push_back(3);` 之後，`v.size()` 是多少？

explanation.zh-Hant: push_back 會把元素附加到結尾，size() 回傳元素數量，因此是 1；3 是元素的值，不是大小。

questions.explanation: push_back appends one element, so size() is 1. The value 3 is stored inside the vector; it is not the size.

questions.prompt: Which of these are sequence containers? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是序列容器？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: vector、list、deque 都是序列容器，元素按位置排列；map 是關聯容器，以鍵排序。

questions.explanation: vector, list and deque are sequence containers ordered by position. map is an associative container ordered by key.

questions.prompt: Which of these are ordered associative containers? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是有序關聯容器？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: set、map、multimap 都以比較器保持鍵的排序；deque 是序列容器，不按鍵排序。

questions.explanation: set, map and multimap keep their keys ordered by a comparator. deque is a sequence container and has no key ordering.

questions.prompt: Iterators are the glue that lets one algorithm work with many container types.

prompt.zh-Hant: 迭代器是讓同一個演算法適用於多種容器的黏合層。

explanation.zh-Hant: 演算法透過迭代器讀寫元素，不依賴容器內部結構；只要迭代器類別符合要求即可。

questions.explanation: Algorithms read and write through iterators rather than container internals, so one algorithm works with any container whose iterator category meets its requirements.

questions.prompt: std::sort is the most efficient choice for sorting a std::list.

prompt.zh-Hant: 對 std::list 排序時，std::sort 是最有效率的選擇。

explanation.zh-Hant: std::sort 需要隨機存取迭代器，list 只提供雙向迭代器；應使用 list 自己的 sort() 成員函式。

questions.explanation: std::sort requires random-access iterators, but std::list only provides bidirectional iterators. Use the list's own sort() member instead.

questions.prompt: The iterator category that std::sort requires is ____-access.

prompt.zh-Hant: std::sort 要求的迭代器類別是 ____ 存取。

explanation.zh-Hant: std::sort 需要隨機存取迭代器，std::vector 與 std::array 都提供；std::list 只有雙向迭代器，因此要用自己的 sort()。

questions.explanation: std::sort needs random-access iterators, which std::vector and std::array provide. std::list only offers bidirectional iterators, so it has its own sort() member.

questions.prompt: Explain why STL algorithms take iterators instead of containers.

prompt.zh-Hant: 說明 STL 演算法為何接收迭代器而不是容器。

model.zh-Hant: 迭代器把「走訪元素」抽象出來，演算法只依賴迭代器介面，因此同一份演算法可套用到 vector、list、陣列甚至檔案串流，而不必為每種容器重寫。

explanation.zh-Hant: 這是編譯期多型與關注點分離：容器管理儲存，演算法只負責操作元素序列。

answer.model: Iterators abstract away element traversal. An algorithm only depends on the iterator interface, so the same sort or find code can work with a vector, a list, a plain array or even a stream, without a separate implementation for each container.

questions.explanation: This is compile-time polymorphism and separation of concerns: containers manage storage, while algorithms operate on a sequence through iterators.
